caption: The video captures the curved, padded interior of a cabin seen through a wide-angle lens, where about a dozen people in dark flight suits occupy the space. Ceiling panels and a bundled rope on the left wall stay fixed, so the motion belongs to the occupants. Several are already drifting between horizontal floating poses and crouched, grounded stances as the clip opens. In the right foreground, a reddish-haired woman is suspended horizontally with arms out, lowers until her feet touch the floor, and settles into a crouch while extending her left arm toward the wall. Behind her, a blonde woman descends from a similar pose to a standing crouch and later stands with one arm extended across the cabin. Along that wall, a man cycles from a tucked float to an upright crouch and back to a horizontal float. In the center, a few occupants remain crouched or seated on the floor, one holding a phone, while at the far-right edge a seated observer becomes visible holding a white-and-red megaphone.
